command: diacritizer\scripts\eval_report.py --ref models\e19\wn2024.gold.raw.pred.ref.txt --manifest research\wn2024_models.json --out-json research\wn2024_full_metrics.json --out-md research\wn2024_full_metrics.md --baseline mishkala --rank-by der_canonical

metric_definitions.der_registered: word error rate, whole '/' token, marks vs the single raw reference line (eval_der parity)
metric_definitions.der_nocase_registered: as der_registered with the trailing case-ending run dropped
metric_definitions.wer_registered: word error rate on exact token equality against the raw reference line
metric_definitions.preserve_registered: share of words whose base letters equal the raw reference's
metric_definitions.der_anyalt: word error rate, marks compared against ANY '/' alternative (registered gate semantics)
metric_definitions.der_anyalt_nocase: as der_anyalt with the trailing case-ending run dropped
metric_definitions.der_canonical: as der_anyalt but with each mark run rewritten to shadda-first order first, so shadda+vowel and vowel+shadda compare equal (the equivalence labels.py declares)
metric_definitions.der_canonical_primary: as der_primary but with shadda/vowel byte order canonicalized
metric_definitions.der_primary: word error rate of the model's FIRST alternative against the reference's FIRST alternative
metric_definitions.der_primary_nocase: as der_primary with the trailing case-ending run dropped
metric_definitions.preserve_primary: share of words whose first-alternative base letters equal the reference's first alternative
metric_definitions.ser: sentence exact-match rate: share of lines where EVERY word is correct under der_anyalt
metric_definitions.der_ambiguous: word error rate restricted to words carrying '/' alternatives
metric_definitions.der_unambiguous: word error rate restricted to words with a single reference form
metric_definitions.case_accuracy: share of words whose FINAL base letter's class matches the reference (i'rab/case ending)
metric_definitions.case_contribution_to_der: der_primary - der_primary_nocase, the case ending's share of word errors
metric_definitions.cder: character-level diacritic error rate: (substitutions+deletions+insertions)/gold diacritic count
metric_definitions.cder_per_position: mark edit operations divided by base-letter positions
metric_definitions.mark_recall: correct marks / marks in the reference
metric_definitions.mark_f1: harmonic mean of mark_precision and mark_recall
metric_definitions.mark_insertions: diacritics emitted where the reference has none
metric_definitions.mark_correct: diacritics emitted at the right position with the right class
metric_definitions.gold_marks: classifiable diacritics in the reference (the CDER and recall denominator)
metric_definitions.pred_marks: classifiable diacritics the model emitted (the precision and density denominator)
metric_definitions.density_gold: marks present in the reference per base-letter position
metric_definitions.density_ratio: density_pred / density_gold; below 1 means systematic under-diacritization
metric_definitions.over_diacritization: share of positions where the model marked a bare reference letter
metric_definitions.under_diacritization: share of positions where the model left a marked reference letter bare
metric_definitions.bare_emission_rate: share of positions the model left unmarked (a silent model scores 1.0 here)
metric_definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean F1 over the classes present in the reference
metric_definitions.weighted_f1: support-weighted mean F1 over the classes present in the reference
metric_definitions.position_accuracy: share of aligned base positions whose 15-class label is correct
metric_definitions.worst_class_recall: lowest per-class recall among classes present; catches rare-class collapse
metric_definitions.collapsed_classes: classes present in the reference with recall exactly 0.0
metric_definitions.alignment_coverage: share of words whose base letters aligned, i.e. the class metrics' denominator
metric_definitions.unclassified_units: base letters carrying a non-classifiable mark (passthrough); excluded from the confusion matrix

not_computed.top_k_accuracy: implemented as eval_metrics.topk_accuracy; needs a per-position logits dump that no script produces yet (CPU-sufficient)
not_computed.calibration_ece_nll_brier: implemented as eval_metrics.expected_calibration_error / negative_log_likelihood / brier_score; needs the same missing logits dump (CPU-sufficient)
not_computed.auc_one_vs_rest: implemented as eval_metrics.auc_ovr; needs the same missing logits dump (CPU-sufficient)
not_computed.latency_throughput: needs the model loaded; not derivable from decoded text
not_computed.oov_conditioned_der: needs the training vocabulary; requires tokenizer + train split
not_computed.idempotence: needs re-inference on the model's own output
not_computed.human_rating: out of scope for an automated harness
